title: Accrued Earnings and Growth: Implications for Future Profitability and Market Mispricing
sources_checked: Paper sample record and model extraction: original sample is 32,961 firm-years, fiscal 1964–1993, with prior/current/subsequent financial and stock data; original product vintages are Compustat 2000 and CRSP 2001 (physical PDF pp. 4–5). Saved original estimate evidence: output/reproductions/packages/W1994228146/attempt_03/tables/table3_eq2.md and review.md. The saved attempt reports 67,585 observations, 30 annual regressions, and GrLTNOA coefficient -0.0364 (t=-4.33).

Fresh native receipt and state: receipt.json reports ok=true, code_unchanged=true, inputs_unchanged=true; SAS build and Stata eq2_fmb returned 0. The native Stata log contains EXT_SAMPLE s1 68134 15840 1998 and all 35 annual fits succeeded.
changes: Pooled the original fiscal-year fit period 1964–1993 with the requested five additional fiscal years 1994–1998, rebuilding the full history and extension together.

Expanded the Compustat construction window to fiscal years 1963–1999. The latest filtered FY1999 DATADATE is 2000-05-31, so CRSP monthly and CCM effective-date bounds run through 31MAY2000; bounded checks confirmed price/share rows through that month.

Extended the annual OLS diagnostics from 1964–1993 to 1964–1998 while keeping the accepted xtfmb Fama–MacBeth estimator, OLS terms, intercept, weighting, covariance choice, screens, and transformations.

Retained YEAR as the estimation clock and DATADATE as a diagnostic column in the SAS-to-Stata handoff. The native fit counts its actual e(sample) and prints the standalone EXT_SAMPLE line for scope s1.

The accepted attempt 03 CRSP/CCM source upper bound was 1994-12-31, before some required FY1994 DATADATEs through 1995-05-31. The pooled build has 549 more original-period observations than the saved attempt (68,134 vs 67,585); the annual aggregate locates the difference in FY1993 (2,965 vs 2,416), with FY1964–1992 counts unchanged. No old generated data were reused and no key-level reconciliation was performed.
limitations: The local Compustat and CRSP files are current local vintages, not the paper's Compustat 2000 and CRSP 2001 releases.
The pooled current-vintage result has 83,974 firm-years versus 32,961 in the paper. The remaining sample-size difference is not attributed to a single cause and was not used to tune the sample.

The saved original-period result has 67,585 firm-years; the rebuilt original period has 68,134 because the prior source upper bound ended before some FY1994 lead dates. This 549-observation change and the move from 30 to 35 annual fits mean the pooled coefficient comparison is not an identical-sample comparison.

The paper does not name the within-year estimator or additional effects; the accepted best-effort specification remains unweighted annual OLS with an intercept, summarized using xtfmb with its accepted default covariance.
The selected FUNDA source has blank ACCTCHG values and lacks item-level footnote data for the voluntary accounting-change screen; this exclusion cannot be implemented from the named fields.
The paper cites legacy Compustat goodwill item 240, but the available historical crosswalk is unresolved; the accepted implementation uses current GDWL by its semantic label as a best-effort proxy.
The paper does not specify the exact CRSP monthly price date rule; the accepted implementation uses the latest month-end on or before DATADATE within 31 days.
The paper reports Table 3 counts of 7/20/3 at a two-sided 1% threshold; the pooled current-vintage fit reports 16/19/0. The reason for this result difference is not isolated to one factor.

analyses.label: Table 3 Equation (2), annual Fama–MacBeth fit (Panels A–C)
analyses.reason: The assigned Table 3 Equation (2) is an observed firm-year population with annual cross-sectional fits over 1964–1993. The pooled rebuild uses the same named Compustat/CRSP/CCM construction through FY1999 supporting statements and CRSP/CCM dates through 2000-05-31. The successful native Fama–MacBeth fit includes 68,134 original-period and 15,840 added-period firm-years through 1998; all 35 annual regressions and equality tests succeeded. The full five-year requested extension is therefore estimable.

analyses.count_unit: Firm-year estimation observation included by xtfmb e(sample), contributing to annual cross-sectional OLS estimates.

comparison.unit: Average annual slope in the decimal-ratio ROA_(t+1) model (ratio outcome per unit change in the ratio regressor).
comparison.comparability: The model terms and units are retained, but the pooled run covers 35 rather than 30 annual fits and its original-period sample is 549 firm-years larger after correcting the prior source date bound; coefficient changes cannot be attributed solely to the five added years.
